programmes.d: The quest for true love begins in Alabama, where four new farmers begin their search for a soulmate.
The farmers go on their first solo dates and Jennifer Nettles leave the farmers a troubling letter.
The farmers and their ladies head to South Carolina for a college football game.
The four farmers head out on their second solo dates.
Ty hosts a roping event at his farm in Missouri. Jennifer encourages the farmers to up the romance.
The farmers are invited on a surprise date with a new potential love match.
The whole crew grows camping and each couple must reckon with their feelings.
The farmers enjoy the final morning of the trip before choosing who they'll take on the next dates.
The ladies get a shocking surprise when they meet their potential in-laws at a special supper.
In the last-ever solo dates, the farmers have one last chance to see where their feelings lie.
The farmers hit the road to visit the first of their two ladies' families.
The four farmers embark on round two of meeting their potential future in-laws.
There's tears, love, and heartbreak as the farmers offer their hearts to the woman of their dreams.
Host Jennifer Nettles and the cast debrief their farm life journey and their quest to find love.
A train passenger behaves oddly en route to Arizona and then disappears. The next day his bloodied body is found in Texas. Dr. G attempts to piece together this bizarre tragedy.
Dr. G must figure out if a decomposed body is that of a local missing woman and if she was murdered.
During her career as a medical examiner, Dr. G has autopsied thousands of murder victims. In this episode, Dr. G shares her most memorable case.
Dr. G reviews a woman's medical records and learns that she suffered from an auto-immune disease called lupus, which might have something to do with her death.
Motor vehicle fatalities account for many of the cases that come into the morgue. Dr. G offers expertise as to how to get behind the wheel and not wind up on a steel table.
When Dr. G receives Lea Conrad's body, she suspects the woman may have died from an antihistamine overdose. Then, Dr. G learns that Lea was being treated for lupus.
An elderly woman is driving when she’s overcome with shooting pains and crashes her car. She’s rushed to the hospital, but the doctors find nothing wrong. Can Dr. G find the cause of death?
Police discover the dead body of Andrew Hopper clutching a syringe and covered with blood. The body is in Dr. G’s hands, as are the clues to solving the case.
Dr. G must determine if a teen boy died by taking his own life, but the autopsy leads to a more shocking and tragic conclusion.
A 71-year-old man wakes in the middle of the night, gasping for air. Paramedics rush to save him, but it’s all in vain: he’s dead by the time they arrive. What caused his death?
Four new farmers. One new host.
One lucky lady from each farm heads up early to enjoy a solo date with her farmer.
After some farmers couldn't decide who to send home, their best friends are called in to help.
